patch_description: The algorithm shifts from a simple probabilistic redex injection to a "forced-structure" approach. It uses a Budget-Scaled Probability for redexes that increases as the term grows, ensuring that large terms are heavily saturated with applied lambdas. To maximize variable usage, it implements a "Context-Aware Type Selection" (CATS) with an 85% bias toward types already in the environment and a "Forced Variable Argument" rule (90% chance) when constructing applications. It also employs a Cubic Recency Bias for variable selection to ensure local variables (especially those from redexes) are prioritized, and an Asymmetric 70/30 Budget Split to create deeper, more complex AST branches.
